author: Krassimir Kossev
releaseNotes:
1.9.4  2026-08-23 maintenance release, no functional changes; it brings the 1.9.3 camera support to HPM users
1.9.3  2026-08-19 Matter 1.5.1 camera: mechanical PTZ control (cluster 0x0552), the camera privacy modes are reported, and a camera endpoint is no longer created as a Motion Sensor when it also reports vision occupancy
1.9.2  2026-08-17 fixed the 'No signature of method: parse()' error logs in the child devices (shades, switches, metering and others - the commands were working, only the confirmation was not logged); the bridge 'Status' attribute is renamed to '_status_' so that it is shown first in the Current States, and the stale entries are removed automatically; Window Shade no longer reports the shade as both open and closed after Initialize; Motion Sensor no longer fabricates a motion event when 'Invert Motion' is toggled; Air Purifier improvements - the 'auto' attribute is reported, new 'filterDaysRemaining' attribute, a filter reset is refused when the device does not accept it, Set Speed is refused on an endpoint with no fan, removed 'Child lock' and 'Set Indicator Status'
1.9.1  2026-08-13 child devices now show the bridged device's SerialNumber and UniqueID in their Device Data (community request #440); the individual gangs of a multi-gang wall switch inherit the real device name instead of all becoming a generic 'Switch' named after the bridge; more reliable discovery - large attribute reads are chunked and automatically retried on bridges that ignore them
1.9.0  2026-07-25 compatibility with the Hubitat inbuilt Matter bridge driver - child devices use the same device network IDs, so a bridge switched over adopts the existing child devices instead of duplicating them (existing MAB installations are not affected); a major refactoring to the new parse(Map) method - the legacy parse(String) path, the 'newParse' preference and the custom TLV decoder are removed; illuminance, temperature, pressure and humidity no longer report a fake 0 when the sensor reports the measurement as invalid; root node battery (IKEA Thread devices); the periodic jobs are scheduled on a fresh install without pressing Save Preferences. NOTE: the driver-side illuminance throttling is replaced by the new 'spammyAttributesMinInterval' preference, which defaults to 0 (off) - the previous 10 seconds throttling is NOT applied until you set it!
1.8.9  2026-05-30 Aqara G350 video camera support (cluster 0x0551)
1.8.8  2026-05-29 Matter Lock Codes - improvements; changed the default timeout to be x2; exception handling in setSwitch() fixed
1.8.7  2026-05-25 Matter Lock Codes - first TEST version; featureMap bug fix; 'ignored invalid illum/lux' warning for zero values is removed
1.8.6  2026-05-10 sbohrer   adds support for Matter Fan control (0x0202). This was tested with an Altitude Boca II ceiling fan (SmartCeilingFan Eran).
1.8.5  2026-05-08 - merged dev. branch to main;
1.8.1 ... 1.8.4 - bug fixes
1.8.0  2026-02-21 - enforcing newParse:true; removing old custom parse code; Button driver improvements; added PressureMeasurement cluster 0x0403 support with 'Generic Component Pressure Sensor'
1.7.8  2026-03-21 lgk      - added delayed illumination handling;
1.7.7 2026-02-14 - newParse:true Matter message parsing improvements; Buttons, CO2, WindowCovering, Power/Energy Measurement improvements; improved diagnostic (UpTime & RebootCount)
1.6.0  2026-01-18 - A major refactoring of the Door Lock driver (PIN codes and Users are NOT working yet!); optimized subsciption management; water leak sensors (deviceType 0x0043) automatic detection
1.5.4  2026-01-08 - added discoveryTimeoutScale; added 'Matter Generic Component Button' driver
1.5.3  2025-06-28 - added custom decodeTLVToHex() and decodeTLV() as a workaround for the Hubitat bug with TLV decoding
1.5.2  2025-05-23 - added 'Matter Custom Component Signal'
1.5.1  2025-04-07 - RMSVoltage and RMSCurrent fix
1.5.0  2025-04-06 - added 'Matter Custom Component Power Energy'
1.4.1  2025-01-12 - restored the commands descriptions
1.4.0  2024-12-26 - HE Platform 2.4.0.x compatibility update
1.3.1  2024-11-12 - bugfix: nullpointer exception in discoverAllStateMachine()
1.3.0  2024-10-10 - adding 'Matter Generic Component Air Purifier' (W.I.P.) : cluster 005B 'AirQuality'
1.2.2  2024-10-11 -  added 'Matter Generic Component SwitchBot Button' by @ymerj
1.2.1  2024-10-05 - thermostatSetpoint attribute is also updated; Matter Events basic decoding (buttons and Locks are still NOT working!); thermostat driver automatic assignment bug fix; checking both 'maxHeatSetpointLimit' and 'absMaxHeatSetpointLimit' when setting the thermostatSetpoint; thermostatOperatingState is updated (digital); thermostat on() and of() commands bug fix;
1.2.0  2024-10-03 - [2.3.9.186] platform: cleanSubscribe; decoded events for child devices w/o the attribute defined are sent anyway; added Matter Thermostats.
1.1.3  2024-08-09 - fixed sendSubsribeList() typo;
1.1.2  2024-07-31  - skipped General Diagnostics cluster 0x0033 discovery - Aqara M3 firmware 4.1.7_0013 returns error reading attribute 0x0000
1.1.1  2024-07-23 kkossev  - (dev.branch) Added Switch capability to the Matter Door Lock component driver.
1.1.0  2024-07-20 - merged pull request from dds82 (added Matter_Generic_Component_Door_Lock); added Identify command; reduced battery attribute subscriptions;
1.0.0 - Initial public release
